title: Colocalization browser focus group recording and slides now available
summary: Video and slides are now available for our Thursday July 13 focus group presentation by Dr. Laura Scott on the colocus browser.
bodyHtml: Video from our Thursday, July 13 KPN focus group is now available on our YouTube channel. Dr. Laura Scott of the University of Michigan presented an in-development browser for visualizing colocalization of quantitative trait loci and GWAS signals. You can download the slide deck here.
